                (reduce (lambda (c2 cell) (let ((nr (+ mr (- (fst cell) sr))) (nc (+ mc (- (snd cell) scc2)))) (if (and (>= nr 0) (< nr oh) (>= nc 0) (< nc ow)) (set-cell c2 nr nc (at g (fst cell) (snd cell))) c2))) can cells))

         (rc-pos (filter (lambda (p) (= rc (cell-at g (fst p) (snd p)))) all-pos))

         (r2 (reduce max -1 (map fst rc-pos)))
         (c1 (reduce min 999 (map snd rc-pos)))
         (c2 (reduce max -1 (map snd rc-pos)))

         (canvas (subgrid g r1 c1 r2 c2))
         (objs (objects-multicolor g))
         (outside-objs (filter (lambda (obj) 
           (for/or (cell (obj-cells obj))
             (let ((r (fst cell)) (c (snd cell)))
               (or (< r r1) (> r r2) (< c c1) (> c c2)))))
           objs)))
    (reduce (lambda (can obj)
      (let* ((cells (obj-cells obj))
             (special-cell (find (lambda (cell) 
               (let ((v (cell-at g (fst cell) (snd cell))))
                 (and (!= v 2) (!= v 0) (!= v rc))))
               cells)))
        (if special-cell
          (let* ((sc (cell-at g (fst special-cell) (snd special-cell)))
                 (sr (fst special-cell)) (scc2 (snd special-cell))
                 (im (find (lambda (p) (and (= sc (cell-at g (fst p) (snd p)))
                                            (>= (fst p) r1) (<= (fst p) r2) (>= (snd p) c1) (<= (snd p) c2)))
                       all-pos)))
            (if im

                    (if (and (>= nr 0) (< nr oh) (>= nc 0) (< nc ow))
                      (set-cell c2 nr nc (cell-at g (fst cell) (snd cell)))
                      c2)))
                  can cells))
              can))
          can)))
      canvas outside-objs))))",
